doctrine: Non observable does not mean unknowable.
Uncertain does not mean all hypotheses are equally plausible.
Strongly constrained counterfactuals should be graded rather than flattened into UNKNOWN.

The judgment fixes registration of the note en délibéré at 15:49.
After reading the judgment, a targeted follow-up was sent to the TA registry at 16:50:46 in the existing thread.
A formal documentary/data access request was sent to the Haute-Corse prefecture at 16:59:13, including preservation of still-existing technical mail logs.

Passive probe execution recovered an explicit prefecture email of 10 September at 20:05 requesting originals for the next day's deposit; the remaining question is whether the judgment's plural reference covers additional requests.
Candidate-side reconstruction now separates the electronic bundle from the physical deposit bundle: the former is largely reconstructed; the latter is only partly reconstructed.
A frozen 12 September trace states that one paper document related to the financial agent was physically presented, while the candidate/replacement CERFA forms were not physically produced on paper.

whether the email/link/video was transmitted to the TA before judgment
identity and registration time of the Sagace 'Réception d'une lettre'
exact time the judgment was rendered or made available
complete inventory of prefecture submissions, including later transmissions
whether the judgment's phrase 'en dépit des demandes des services préfectoraux' refers only to the documented 10 September request for originals or also to additional requests
exact physical bundle shown, handed over, retained or returned during the 11 September deposit, including recovery of the primary provisional receipt if still available
existence of a separate hearing trace, confirmation of the hearing clerk, and access rules for the signed minute

cross_scale_candidate_2026_09_26.status: candidate analogy; not an identity claim
individual_scale: Laurence Vernerey: public senatorial dossier documents a recognized disability situation; do not publish medical details.
Marie-Louise: protection-responsable source documents disability and a late administrative request; do not infer unrecorded recognition or diagnosis.
collective_scale: French institutional discourse has repeatedly used the expression 'handicap(s) de l'insularité' for Corsican structural constraints.
cross_scale_candidate_2026_09_26.candidate_invariant: Formal possibility does not by itself create effective capability when access conditions, accommodations, means, or institutional conversions are missing.
anti_overreach: Do not equate individual disability law with territorial constitutional law.
Treat the lexical parallel as a prompt for a structural test, not as proof.
editorial_use: Quasi-real-time journal note already recorded on 26 September.
cross_scale_candidate_2026_09_26.privacy_rule: Minimize third-party health data; no medical documents, diagnoses, or non-public details.

editorial_interest: A live example of the gap between procedural movement and actual uncertainty reduction.
A contemporary cross-scale Reality Case for traceability, effective capacity, and the distinction between formal rights and usable access paths.
A test of diplomatic escalation: make external review paths visible without turning a factual access request into an accusation.
A live demonstration of generative probe yield: passive source reconstruction produced a new distinction between the electronic bundle and the physical deposit bundle, and generated RP-SEN-18.
senatoriales_2026_post_judgment.privacy_rule: Do not reproduce raw postal photos, signatures, addresses, technical logs, or non-public personal data; project only the facts they establish after minimization.

procedural_reactivation_register.editorial_role: Map which 2024–2026 acts are still open, reactivable, merely probative, or require legal qualification; keep compensation analysis separate from factual reconstruction.
n3_candidate_angles: Une procédure fermée peut rester une preuve ; une voie expirée peut conduire à une nouvelle demande distincte.
Le principe d'effectivité se teste aussi dans la capacité à retrouver, transmettre et réactiver les traces.
Réparer ne signifie pas additionner les griefs : il faut identifier chaque titulaire, préjudice, causalité, prescription et juridiction.
procedural_reactivation_register.ddd_probe: Open DDD-01 minimally under the explicit theme 'principe d'effectivité', then enrich by documented continuity.

weekend_magazine_2026_09_26.editorial_role: high-intensity late-week delta, not a license to lower evidentiary standards

electoral.note: Treat successive candidacies, substitutions and remedies as a continuity-of-capacity series, not as evidence of one political intention.

protection.note: Includes the earlier judicial/educational protection history; exact chronology remains source-driven and must not be filled narratively.

weekend_magazine_2026_09_26.central_question: How do formal rights, protections and possible actions become usable capabilities across institutional hand-offs, and where do those conversions fail?

electoral_capability_2022.status: documented post-n2 consolidation; candidate for n3
established: 1 May: JHR publicly announces himself as titular candidate; 6 May he still forwards that state to Martine Brillais.
9 May: operational Trello trace records Marie-Louise as candidate and JHR as replacement; the exact 6–9 May decision remains unknown.
19 May: provisional prefecture receipt records Mme BARONNE ML MARIANI as candidate and M. BARON JHN MARIANI as replacement.
24 May: Marie-Louise personally forwards CHORUS material and then transmits two successive collector PDFs from her two accounts.

Technical inspection ties the two collector PDFs to the same Adobe Photoshop CC 2018 (Macintosh) document created 24 May at 15:18:45 +02:00; the observable revision is essentially the addition of the yanug.
Damien Ruvet's returned collector version is dated/sent on 25 May, after the two states transmitted by Marie-Louise.
third_party: 16 May: Martine Brillais writes that Marie-Louise 'a pris l'initiative de se présenter'; retain as THIRD-PARTY, not VOICE.
unknown: exact origin and decision process of the 6–9 May role reversal
identity of the person physically operating Photoshop
authorship of the portrait/autoportrait and exact initial composition
interpretation_boundary: Document increasing/exercised electoral capacity, not a reconstructed political psychology.
Direct material/versioning participation does not equal sole graphic authorship.
The documented 2019 purchase of a MacBook Pro is contextual provenance only; it does not identify the 2022 device.
editorial_interest: A concrete bridge from 2017 substitute status to 2022 titular acts and 2024 direct political VOICE.
A small-scale example of capability becoming observable through acts, documents and production rather than through retrospective motive attribution.

editorial_figure.title: Quand une possibilité devient une capacité exercée
editorial_figure.geometry: horizontal timeline; local 2020 closure reconnecting to 2022; no ascending scale
editorial_figure.sequence: 2017 OPEN/EXERCISE → 2020 OPEN/EXERCISE/CLOSE-local → 2022 REOPEN/EXPAND/EXERCISE → 2024 MAINTAIN/EXERCISE + direct VOICE
editorial_figure.key_boundary: 2024 VOICE changes the nature of available evidence; it is not a score or a claim of greater subjective commitment.

bounded_loss_of_chance.rule: Map real contemporaneous possibilities, conversion conditions and closure points; do not infer the final outcome from one lost branch.

procedural_routes_as_probes: possible QPC, only after exact statutory target and constitutional grievance are identified
Défenseur des droits as a candidate continuity / cross-institution probe
possible ECHR route, subject to admissibility and exhaustion requirements
civil or administrative compensation routes, including bounded loss-of-chance analysis
n3_editorial_candidates: From formal protection to effective capability: a longitudinal map rather than a single-case narrative.
2017–2026 electoral continuity as an observable series of openings, frictions, remedies and closures.
2024 complaints as contemporaneous pre-death traces, kept distinct from later causal inference.
2026 senatorial case as a live probe of transmission, deadlines, evidence access and correctability.
Continuity of protection: when each institution has a segment but no actor owns the transition.
Magazine close: what the Real answered during the final weekend before freeze.
anti_overreach: No single institutional episode is promoted to a complete explanation of Marie-Louise's death.
No absence of response is treated as evidence of hostile intent.
No cross-scale recurrence is treated as identity of mechanism.
Legal routes remain separate until jurisdiction, standing, deadlines and admissibility are verified.

mail_consolidation_2026_09_28.status: integrated at Corpus level; private bodies and images withheld
marie_louise_editorial_effect: Rebalance the book layer toward Marie-Louise acting, creating, transmitting and relating, not only institutions acting upon her.
Record newly surfaced works, photographs and holders as trace leads; publication rights remain separate.
Preserve refus, adverse accounts and contradictions as methodological evidence against confirmation bias.
procedure_effect: TJ Grasse supplied a parquet reference for PV 03632/2024 and identified the Bureau d'ordre as the handling service; transmission to the competent magistrate is conditional on identity verification.
senatorial_effect: The Interior Ministry data-protection service reported that the requested published candidate data had been removed after cancellation of the candidacy, so the rectification request could no longer be performed on that publication.
36 blank and 40 invalid ballots are observed facts; their motives and counterfactual allocation under a different candidate set remain UNKNOWN.
mail_consolidation_2026_09_28.privacy_rule: Register existence, provenance, status and documentary consequences; do not reproduce private email bodies, images or sensitive details without a separate publication decision.

magazine_recurring_rubrics.status: candidate recurring structure from n3 onward

rubrics.function: External answers, institutional replies and observable consequences since the previous issue.
New archives, testimonies, works, photographs and holders, with provenance and publication status.
What changed between FACT / TESTIMONY / HYPOTHESIS / UNKNOWN.
One bounded case examined deeply without absorbing the whole issue.
Contradictions, adverse evidence and observations that resist the current interpretation.
Open packets, next probes and explicit closure conditions.

magazine_recurring_rubrics.composition_rule: The main body narrates; annexes and Corpus records carry exhaustive proof and detail.

individual: What did sparse P0 recall reveal that the inquiry had not prompted?
Which works, objects, photographs and memories are still held by Marie-Louise's friends?
Can the Villa Arson rejection be recovered as a primary institutional decision?
What can new witnesses actually date or constrain about the under-documented periods?
What exact institutional setting connected Marie-Louise to Jean-Joseph Albertini’s 2016–2017 arts workshop, and what do the three photographs establish?
method: How much knowledge can be recovered by asking sparsely rather than supplying the investigator's categories?
How should strongly constrained counterfactuals be used without either free fiction or defensive agnosticism?
collective: Does an autonomy proposal create effective capacity or merely formal permission?
How far does the handicap / insularity parallel survive an invariance test before it becomes only metaphor?
What do the first #1755 Reality Tests reveal about access to historians, archives and local institutional memory?
When a procedural record remains incomplete, which access path actually reduces the uncertainty: direct answer, document access, data access, or later judicial production?
Can a request make possible escalation routes explicit while preserving cooperation and avoiding premature attribution of intent?

constitutional_effectivity_projection_20.status: public external Reality Case; candidate contextual source for n3
constitutional_effectivity_projection_20.role: Cross-scale test of the conversion from formal possibility to effective capability: implementation conditions, use/non-use, periodic evaluation, observable effects and correction.
constitutional_effectivity_projection_20.invariant_candidate: A formally open right or faculty is not by itself an effectively usable capability.
anti_overreach: Do not treat territorial constitutional law and individual protection law as identical mechanisms.
Do not infer causation in Marie-Louise's case from the constitutional analogy.
Do not describe the amendment as filed, supported or adopted unless a later trace establishes that fact.
editorial_use: Possible sidebar or methodological bridge for n3.
Useful for the longitudinal effectivity axis only if it clarifies the individual case rather than displacing it.

capable_public_announcement_2026_09_27.status: observed public delta; candidate contextual source for n3
established: Capable is publicly announced as a movement.
The announcement explicitly links Capable to the Principe d'effectivite.
It states Liberté, Égalité, Fraternité effectives as a goal.
It links the movement to Autonomie de Capacité and #Suvranu.
does_not_establish: a retroactive Capable label for earlier candidacies
any political continuity attributable to Marie-Louise after her death
inquiry_role: Public Reality Test of a doctrine leaving the Corpus and entering the political world.
Future effects, objections and corrections may feed back into the Corpus.
editorial_use: Late-delta candidate for n3; useful as a short methodological bridge rather than a programmatic manifesto.
Can document the sequence doctrine -> public projection -> future response of the Real.
anti_overreach: Suicide Corse is not a Capable manifesto.
Do not rewrite source-locked historical chapters to make them foreshadow the movement.
Do not project Capable retroactively onto Marie-Louise's political history.

responsibility_effectivity_projection_20.role: Adds a temporal and institutional test to longitudinal closure/protection cases.
test: When did the effect become detectable?
When was it known or reasonably knowable?
Which authority had real corrective capacity?
Was the corrective window still open?
What reaction followed within a reasonable time?
responsibility_effectivity_projection_20.guardrail: Informed persistence is a candidate qualification, never automatic proof of individual or institutional fault.

checks: Marie-Louise is not projected as a posthumous supporter or source of Capable.
The 2026 senatorial candidacy is not retroactively relabeled Capable.
Effectivity doctrine remains distinct from positive law and from political projection.
Capable is treated as a new public Reality Test, not as proof that the doctrine is correct.
The X wording faut is preserved as the public trace; vaut remains the canonical Corpus formulation.
